sharedOwnership.miniprogram/app.json: Shared navigation: only three existing note-page registrations; no home/tab/photo wiring. Atomic dependency of note entry -> directory/practice/memory.
sharedOwnership.scripts/build-note-runtime.js: Shared builder: notes-only switch plus note-summary generation; original default common-sense branch retained. Atomic reproducibility dependency of generated note mirrors/summary.
sharedOwnership.docs/knowledge-platform/README.md: Shared document entry: notes status/history/current-plan links only.
sharedOwnership.miniprogram/subpackages/note/shared: Shared within the note module: source detail/card/practice templates and styles; not a global UI component change.
sharedOwnership.miniprogram/subpackages/note/services/tr: Note-side adapter to existing training destinations; public training config, pages, storage and scoring not modified.
sharedOwnership.historicalCommonSenseArchive: 13-file source/reference snapshot in evidence archive only; not new active common-sense or training runtime. Do not restore into other modules automatically.

singleCommitReason: Current note entry links require the three new page registrations, which require their page/service/generated/source files. The notes-only builder is needed to reproduce those artifacts. Save as one dependency-complete WIP checkpoint; shared deltas remain separately attributed, not claimed pure content. Future integration must reconcile shared paths explicitly.
